title: Helpful Agent Meets Deceptive Judge: Understanding Vulnerabilities in Agentic Workflows

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the robustness of a generator LLM against deceptive or hypercritical LLM judges by measuring how often the generator abandons its initially correct answers when presented with authoritative but misleading feedback (using zero-knowledge templates, hallucinated parametric claims, or adversarial web-retrieved evidence).
